M-DBG-UI.Purpose: Declarative FlexVerse inspector UI with context selection, hierarchy, property details and preferences.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: InspectorApp, hierarchy/property/behavior views, header tabs and native settings controls.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Snapshot capture and target observation belong to M-DBG-INSPECT.

Requirements.REQ-001: All UI uses FlexVerse widgets; scrollable components derive from ScrollView and decorative compositions use View.
Requirements.REQ-002: Expanded rows, open member drawers, filters and active tab are instance State; target context and selection arrive as controlled Props.
Requirements.REQ-003: Stable widget/property keys preserve UI identity across snapshot refreshes. Changing values are passed as reactive Props or computed projections instead of manual dirty/reconcile signals.
Requirements.REQ-004: Preferences use native Checkbox and HorizontalSlider with OnValueChange; disabling heatmap disables its duration slider.
Requirements.REQ-005: Empty registries display a useful prompt; self-inspection and invented behavior metadata are excluded.

Inputs.IN-001: DebugNode snapshots, context keys, selection, settings values and change callbacks.

Outputs.OUT-001: Inspector UI rendered by InspectorWindow through FVUI.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Reports selection/context changes and writes user preferences through controlled callbacks.
